label: Frame Counter
author: Conky-Studio
description: Increments every sensor refresh while Enabled ≥ 0.5. Resets when Enabled drops. Useful for stepped animations and cycle indexes.

properties.label: Wrap at
properties.help: 0 = no wrap. Otherwise counter resets after reaching this value.

properties.label: State key (unique)
properties.help: Unique id so multiple counters do not share STATE.
